purpose: Free-trial capability audit to determine whether TheStatsAPI can satisfy the existing Step H market and temporal requirements before any new holdout is observed.

provider.name: TheStatsAPI
provider.trial: 7-day free trial; all endpoints documented as available during trial

audit_scope.allowed_data: current/upcoming fixtures and provider documentation only

execution_sequence: Authenticate trial key without persisting credential
Resolve one or more current/upcoming matches in each target competition
Fetch standard odds payload and enumerate exact corners market keys/schema
Fetch full odds history for sampled matches where available
Verify bookmaker identity and timestamp fields
Verify Total Corners half-point two-sided pairs
Search explicitly for home-team and away-team corner total contracts
Produce capability matrix per competition and contract
Only if all mandatory capabilities are proven may a new historical holdout protocol be frozen
promotion_rule: This audit cannot release Step I. Passing only authorizes pre-registration of a separate TheStatsAPI historical holdout. Failure leaves H open for source remediation.
